propositions: A new plan-review criterion ac-process-gate must detect and flag acceptance criteria that are indistinguishable generic mechanical gates (children-closed, tests/CI/build pass, plan-review passes) that any ticket would satisfy identically, rather than ticket-specific deliverable outcomes.

The ac-process-gate criterion must PASS acceptance criteria that name or depend on the specific ticket's deliverable—artifact, behavior, contract, test, doc, config, or criterion—even if their subject is tooling or process (e.g. 'E2E tests written covering feature X', 'plan-review criteria updated to rubric Y').

The ac-process-gate criterion must be registered as a 1-TURN, advisory, non-codebase-grounded member of CANONICAL_LLM with routing scope [container, leaf] and facet ac-text-quality, with a two-key checklist (not-applicable pass for empty-AC plans; per-AC judgment of generic-gate vs deliverable-specific).

The ac-process-gate rubric and unit tests must document the error-toward-silence anti-false-positive rule and the litmus-test discriminator ('would this exact AC read identically on an arbitrary unrelated ticket?'), with live bounded-sanity eval confirming recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0 on committed fire/no-fire corpus.
